C1213.title: FBI Investigated 982 SIM Swap Attacks in 2024, Losses Approached $26 Million
C1213.summary: According to data cited by Avast, FBI IC3 recorded 982 SIM-swap-related complaints in 2024, with total losses near 26 million US dollars. Attackers deceive mobile carriers into transferring victim phone numbers to SIM cards they control, intercept verification codes, and take over financial accounts. This wording uses the IC3 complaint-recording framing and should not be stated as the FBI investigated 982 cases.
